verdict.rationale: The only nearby feature is Open Quickly (Cmd-Shift-O), which is documented as a search for switching between sessions by tab title, command, hostname, directory, or badge. That is session navigation, not a palette for discovering and running terminal actions. Global Search, the searchable profiles database, and Cmd-; autocomplete are also related features that don't deliver a command palette, so nothing in the evidence shows the product delivers this story.
